<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed a meeting time and created the booking. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The confirmed time is Thursday at 14:30.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to send the email.
The email should include the day and time of the meeting.
I will write a simple and professional email body.
After sending the email, the task will be complete, so I will end my session.
This will take two actions: one to send the email and one to end the session.
I will start by sending the email.
